title: A characterization of tight ($ k, 0 $)-stable graphs
summary: Let k and l be two non-negative integers with k > l. A graph G is (k,l)-stable if alpha(G - S) >= alpha(G) - l for every subset S of V(G) with |S| = k, where alpha(G) denotes the independence number of G. Dong and Wu established that alpha(G) = 4. In particular, we prove that tight (k, 0)-stable graphs are K_{k+1} and K_{k+2} for k >= 5, which not only extends the result of Liu, Song and Wang [J. Graph Theory 110(2) (2025), 193-199] from k >= 24 to k >= 5, but also proves the conjecture of Dong and Luo [Electron. J. Comb. 32(4) (2025), 4-45] once more.
